what: Plan hardens snapshot files to 0444 but does not clear stale snapshot artifacts before the next write
scenario_or_breakage: After an interrupted or repeated run reuses the same round snapshot path, redirects to pre-existing 0444 files fail; the current pre-coder-head branch removes the file after the failed redirect but does not retry, so the round runs without carryover snapshots
suggested_fix: Before writing a round snapshot, rm -f the known snapshot files/globs in snap_dir, then write and harden them; apply the same stale-file cleanup to the MAV pre-coder-head write path if it can reuse the same snap_dir
